latest.title: 3 Weekend Projects That Taught Me More Than Any Textbook
latest.description:
When I first started learning cloud computing, I did what everyone does: I read documentation, watched endless video tutorials, and memorized definitions. But honestly? None of it stuck. The theories felt abstract, and I didn't feel like a real "builder."
Everything changed when I stopped reading and started building.
If you are a student trying to break into cloud computing, skip the passive scrolling. Here are three simple, hands-on weekend projects that completely transformed my understanding.

latest.title: I Built an Agentic SRE on AWS DevOps Agent — Here's What the Official Guide Left Out
latest.description: I built an autonomous SRE agent using AWS DevOps Agent that investigates Lambda incidents without waking me up — correlating CloudWatch metrics, logs, and GitHub deployments, then posting root cause analysis to Slack. This post covers the full CDK implementation in a single AWS account (no Splunk, no 3-account setup), the webhook handler with HMAC signing, and the one thing the official docs don't mention: the SKILL.md frontmatter requirement that causes silent upload failures.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: NeuroVoice
trending.description: Small moments, repeated daily, reveal what single snapshots never can - patterns that quietly signal neurological risk. NeuroVoice is a multimodal Parkinson’s screening platform that tracks pattern over time to detect subtle neurological changes early.

trending.title: Start Your Cloud Journey Today with the AWS Builder Center
trending.description:
As we gather for the first AWS Student Community Day in Cameroon, it’s the perfect moment to introduce you to a platform that will help you keep building long after our event ends: the AWS Builder Center.

Builder Center is a free community hub (you can sign up at builder.aws.com), built around three core pillars—Learn, Connect, and Build—and it’s designed to take you from foundational knowledge to real‑world project experience, without ever needing a credit card.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: Global Impact AI Navigator
trending.description: Global Impact AI Navigator (GIAN) is a multi-agent AI platform built on Amazon Bedrock that transforms a raw idea into a complete strategic package in under 60 seconds — SWOT diagnostic, live-grounded funding discovery, personalized roadmap, and a context-aware advisor. Designed for innovators in emerging markets, it democratizes access to the strategic guidance that usually requires expensive consultants or elite networks.
